results.title: Resonance
results.overview: A hermit lives in voluntary exile from civilisation, attuned to the ebbs and flows of nature. In the sleepy town beneath his cabin, a young, ambitious policeman is being groomed to uphold the status quo after the retirement of his corrupt chief. When a shady local strongman's plans to legitimise his grip on the town are obstructed by the hermit's defence of the natural environment, the conflict between the two slowly simmers to a boil beneath the howl of the malfunctioning sirens of the town's Early Warning System.

results.title: Notice Death
results.overview: A number of people receive death threats from a mysterious mentally ill person, and these threats quickly turn into real crimes out of revenge. A police officer undertakes the task of investigating to uncover the truth and achieve justice, but his job becomes more difficult as the threads of cases linked to each victim become intertwined.

results.title: I'm Not Your Heartthrob
results.overview: A documentary exploring acclaimed Brazilian actor Claudio Marzo’s relationship with fame and his own image as a heartthrob.

results.title: DEI
results.overview: A bigoted man finds himself in an unlikely body on Día de los Muertos.

results.title: Someone's Daughter
results.overview: A criminal defence lawyer, Sam, (Pascale Bussières, Ma Vie en cinémascope, When Night is Falling), finds herself kidnapped and abandoned on a remote island along with former client Paul (François Arnaud, Heated Rivalry, Fucktoys, The Borgias), who she previously cleared of sexual assault charges. As they make their way through the unrelenting Canadian wilderness, Paul’s behaviour forces Sam to question the man she once defended. As doubt gives way to fear, she finds herself facing a choice no lawyer should ever have to make.

results.title: Gabon Uncharted
results.overview: Tackling colossal waterfalls in Gabon, kayakers Adrian Mattern, Dane Jackson, Bren Orton and Kalob Grady's story of high-stakes adventure reveals the gritty reality behind the veneer of social media.

results.title: The Soul Whisperer
results.overview: Theresia stays by the bedsides of the dying, praying for them and helping them pass away in peace. At the bedside of Varkichan, a wealthy farmer, she urges him to repent and forgive, but the stubborn Varkichan has no intention of dying this way, nor does he want to show any weakness to his son George and George’s wife, who have returned after ten years and are now waiting for him to die. How can the long suffering and inherited anger that have tormented everyone in the family finally be brought to an end?

results.title: Surprise! I Love You
results.overview: Imani travels to Jamaica to surprise the man she thinks could be the one. But when her romantic surprise takes an unexpected turn, the trip she imagined quickly falls apart.  Heartbroken and far from home, Imani has to figure out what comes next. What follows is a funny, heartfelt story about friendship, family, Black love, relationships and finding romance where you least expect it, all set against the beauty, energy and culture of Jamaica.

results.title: Kidnapped by My Mum
results.overview: At 11 years old, Alex Batty vanished on what was supposed to be a short family holiday with his mother and grandfather. An international missing persons investigation was launched, but years passed without a trace.  Then, six years later, a teenager appeared on the side of a road in the French Pyrenees and told a passing driver that he'd been kidnapped.  Alex, now aged 20, is ready to tell the full story about his abduction and his life on the run. For the first time, he retraces the route of his disappearance across Spain and France, uncovering not just how he was hidden but the belief system that kept him there. Each revelation builds a chilling picture of how easy it was for a child to disappear in plain sight.

results.title: The Knot
results.overview: In the Podlasie countryside of the late 1950s, Zośka grows up marked by the Polish plait: a symbol of shame and rural fears. Hoping that obedience will bring her love, she tries to escape the family stigma. Years later, she realises that her mother’s fate has befallen her. When her daughter’s future is in danger, for the first time, Zośka stands up to the world that taught her to be quiet.

results.title: Judy Pipkins Is Home Again
results.overview: 24 year old actor Judy Pipkins has spent her days doing nothing for the last eight months - this is one of those days.

results.title: One More Game
results.overview: Martin, a 16-year-old from Čučer-Sandevo, Macedonia, dreams of becoming a star as a professional gamer — an aspiration that conflicts with his mother’s wishes for him to have a traditional education. When his best friend, Dimitar, gets the opportunity to try out for Europe’s top eSports team, Dynasty, Martin eagerly embraces the chance to make his mark.

results.title: Glowing
results.overview: GLOWING by Beth B is not just a film, but an immersive, genre-defying experience that blurs the boundaries between documentary, narrative, experimental cinema, and music video.Eight fearless artists step into the frame — their voices raw, their stories electric. As poets, musicians, and performers reveal deeply personal truths, their stories collide and intertwine, forming a powerful, living dialogue with the audience. What unfolds is not simply storytelling, but an invitation: to feel, to witness, to connect.

results.title: WWE NXT Countdown To Stand & Deliver 2026
results.original_title: WWE NXT Countdown To Stand & Deliver 2026
results.overview: A major 10-Person Mixed Tag Team Match will take place on the NXT Stand & Deliver Countdown Show. Women’s Speed Champion Wren Sinclair, Hank & Tank, Shiloh Hill and Eli Knight will team against TNA Knockouts Champion Arianna Grace, Channing “Stacks” Lorenzo, Lexis King, Uriah Connors and Charlie Dempsey. Birth Right have not been shy when it comes to sharing their feelings about their peers, and now the makeshift team of Superstars will aim to silence them once and for all. Which dream team will walk out of St. Louis with the victory?

results.title: Baise-en-ville
results.overview: Sprite, a 20-year-old young adult, returns to Chelles after a breakup. To pay for his driver’s license and please his parents, he joins Allo Nettoyo, a night-time cleaning start-up in the Paris suburbs. Unable to get around without a permit, he adopts the "baise-en-ville" technique—taught by his driving instructor—which involves spending the night at girls' places of girls he meets through a dating app. Sprite struggles with this new approach to seduction.

results.title: Mr. Wonderful
results.overview: A deep dive into the world of Luiz de Freitas (better known as Mr. Wonderful), Brazil’s first Black fashion designer. Born in Pau Grande, in the interior of Rio de Janeiro state, he defied conventions and revolutionized Brazilian menswear with his unique personality, his brand, and his fashion shows.

results.title: Jhingedaau 2
results.overview: As Khanalni goes missing, her two sons and their wives embark on a search to find her, uncovering unexpected challenges along the way.

results.title: The Pentagon UFO Tapes
results.overview: The truth takes flight.  For decades, the U.S. military denied the truth. Now, declassified footage reveals an unidentified, craft-defying explanation. This film uncovers America’s UFO secrets from Roswell to the latest Pentagon leaks.  Declassified military footage. Unexplained aerial encounters. From Roswell to the Pentagon’s shocking leaks, this gripping doc exposes decades of UFO secrets the government tried to hide.
